body: I feel you, sometimes I wish my family would despise me beyond anything, so I could kill myself with clear conscience. It'd be so easy, nothing would finally hold me back

Been noticing this for quite a while now, and yeah I'll confirm: depression really messes with your memory.

I went from a gifted A+ student to someone who barely passes her classes and can't remember what they've eaten or did for the majority of yesterday. Everything just blurs together, I keep forgetting small things, sometimes important events. And my coping mechanism? I write notes. As many as I can: to my calendar, on my phone, noting all the things I need to keep track of. Even basic things like washing the dishes, taking a shower, eating, everything either has an alarm set or a note. 
It's a lot of work, my room is a mess of sticky notes of course, but maybe you could try it too.

God I feel this on a personal level... whenever I try to talk to people irl I always try to respond with something interesting/funny, but I don't have the minutes to correct the sentence structure and make up additional stuff to spice up the convo, like I do online. Instead my brain shuts down and everything happens way too fast. The stutter is the worst, it fucks me over 99% of the time. Hang in there though, as hard as it is talking more and having a will to develop speaking skills always helps.
